schema_evidence.files:
CREATE TABLE files (
  file_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  language TEXT NOT NULL,
  content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  content_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
  line_count INTEGER,
  indexed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_revision_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL,
  metadata_json TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (last_revision_id) REFERENCES extraction_revisions(revision_id)
)
schema_evidence.symbols:
CREATE TABLE symbols (
  symbol_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  file_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  language TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  signature TEXT,
  doc_comment TEXT,
  visibility TEXT,
  parent_symbol_id TEXT,
  start_line INTEGER NOT NULL,
  start_column INTEGER NOT NULL,
  end_line INTEGER NOT NULL,
  end_column INTEGER NOT NULL,
  start_byte INTEGER NOT NULL,
  end_byte INTEGER NOT NULL,
  body_start_line INTEGER,
  body_start_column INTEGER,
  body_end_line INTEGER,
  body_end_column INTEGER,
  body_start_byte INTEGER,
  body_end_byte INTEGER,
  body_hash TEXT,
  semantic_group TEXT,
  confidence REAL,
  content_type TEXT,
  is_test INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  test_container INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  test_lifecycle INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  metadata_json TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (file_id) REFERENCES files(file_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (parent_symbol_id) REFERENCES symbols(symbol_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
schema_evidence.identifiers:
CREATE TABLE identifiers (
  identifier_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  reference_site_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  language TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  containing_symbol_id TEXT,
  target_symbol_id TEXT,
  start_line INTEGER NOT NULL,
  start_column INTEGER NOT NULL,
  end_line INTEGER NOT NULL,
  end_column INTEGER NOT NULL,
  start_byte INTEGER NOT NULL,
  end_byte INTEGER NOT NULL,
  confidence REAL NOT NULL,
  code_context TEXT,
  metadata_json TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (reference_site_id) REFERENCES reference_sites(reference_site_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (file_id) REFERENCES files(file_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (containing_symbol_id) REFERENCES symbols(symbol_id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (target_symbol_id) REFERENCES symbols(symbol_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
schema_evidence.identifier_resolutions:
CREATE TABLE identifier_resolutions (
  identifier_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
    REFERENCES identifiers(identifier_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  target_symbol_id TEXT
    REFERENCES symbols(symbol_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  tier INTEGER,
  confidence REAL,
  method TEXT,
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
  candidates INTEGER,
  resolved_at_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((outcome = 'resolved') = (target_symbol_id IS NOT NULL))
)

scale_projection.basis: inference, not measured — no dotnet/runtime clone on this box

G3.threshold: miller resolution >= 50k rows/s; diff+delta write <= +50% of the resolution phase; store-real background <= 30,000 ms
G3.gate_scope: miller pairs whose base artifact holds >= 1000 files (the fixture scale band the Ph0 anchors were measured on)

G4.threshold: delta enumeration <= the diff's own cost, every pair

G5.threshold: store-real background < 24390 ms on the miller corpus; foreground bind writes 0 identifier rows
G5.gate_scope: miller pairs whose base artifact holds >= 1000 files (the fixture scale band the Ph0 anchors were measured on)
